ora·ïto — projects — Chesty

Chesty

Category Furniture
Brand Dunlopillo
Collection Dunlopillo
Year 2012

Chesty, very contemporary line accentuated by piping and a padded seat. The rounded design of this model as well as the modularity offered by the different elements (sofas, armchair, fireside chair, ottoman) brings personality to all living rooms.

By creating a line of “new generation” seats for Dunlopillo, Ora-Ito wanted to invent a modular and easy-to-use collection: sofa, lounge, pouf, convertible devoid of any complex handling. From small to large interiors, models that suit all lifestyles.

simplicity is
